consentText.en: This profile only changes the DNS resolver used by this device to an encrypted one (DNS over HTTPS / DNS over TLS). It does not install certificates, VPNs, or any management. You can remove it at any time from Settings.
consentText.zh-Hant: 此描述檔只會把裝置使用的 DNS 解析器改成加密連線（DNS over HTTPS / DNS over TLS），不會安裝憑證、VPN 或任何管理設定，隨時可在「設定」中移除。
